secondSummary:
Project LANTERN is currently managed by owner Mira, with final port 7319 and deadline set to 2026-11-18. The project's release status remains blocked due to an unresolved checksum audit, with the rollback artifact identified as lantern-r17.zip. No release authorization has been granted for Project LANTERN based on the provided data.  

Independent verifications for items ITEM-6 through ITEM-39 confirm successful record counts across respective shards (S6–S39) with varying retry counts, all resulting in valid outputs (item-*.csv), but these results do not authorize release for other projects.  

Additional verification checks CHECK-40 through CHECK-79 confirm that each batch dataset (batch-40.csv to batch-79.csv) contains the expected number of rows (ranging from 920 to 1817), passed validation, and were reviewed by designated reviewers (reviewer-0 to reviewer-3). These checks are isolated to their respective datasets and do not impact Project LANTERN’s release status.  

The checksum audit remains pending, and no further updates have resolved this blocker. Uncertainty persists regarding when or if the audit will be completed.
